headline: OpenMAIC Builds Autonomous AI Classrooms
lede: This framework shifts educational delivery from static documents to interactive, multi-agent workflows. It integrates modular LLM orchestration to generate curricula that adapt in real-time to student needs.

headline: Standardizing Agentic Research Workflows
lede: Scientific Agent Skills provides a portable plugin architecture for high-level laboratory automation. By bridging AI reasoning with specialized databases, it enables researchers to perform complex computational tasks locally.

headline: Provision Virtualized iPhone Environments Locally
lede: The vphone-cli utility leverages native virtualization to orchestrate iOS firmware and hardware emulation on Apple Silicon. It provides a vital bridge for developers and security researchers needing repeatable, software-defined testing platforms.

headline: Archify Maps Complex System Architecture
lede: Turn abstract technical concepts into production-ready diagrams with this CLI-driven visualization engine. It supports multiple formats and themes, streamlining the documentation process for rapid iterative design.

headline: Heretic Strips Model Safety Alignments
lede: This research tool uses directional ablation to remove restrictive refusal vectors from transformer models. By automating parameter optimization, it restores model performance without manual fine-tuning efforts.

headline: Crawl4AI Bridges Web Data To LLMs
lede: Transform complex, dynamic web content into structured Markdown for high-throughput RAG systems. This asynchronous crawler removes reliance on proprietary APIs, keeping data pipelines fast and transparent.

headline: Last30Days Synthesizes Community Truth
lede: This synthesis agent aggregates social engagement data to bypass traditional search biases. It provides a grounded summary of current events based on verified consensus rather than SEO ranking.

headline: IPATool Simplifies Apple App Management
lede: Retrieve encrypted application binaries directly with this versatile Go-based CLI utility. It offers a standardized approach for researchers to handle app metadata and version tracking across the entire Apple ecosystem.

headline: Awesome MCP Servers Expands AI Interoperability
lede: This curated repository serves as a centralized index for the Model Context Protocol ecosystem. It enables developers to integrate diverse APIs, databases, and local tools into standardized agentic frameworks.

headline: Checkstyle Enforces Enterprise Java Standards
lede: Maintain consistent codebases and minimize technical debt with this rigorous auditing tool. It integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines to ensure compliance with predefined formatting and logic rules.
